prompt: Illustrate Android architecture excluding the application (app) layer. List the other five layers and at least two components in each layer.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] best follows the prompt by listing exactly the five expected Android architecture layers excluding the app layer (Linux kernel, HAL, native libraries, Android runtime, application framework) and gives at least two components for each, without major factual errors. Candidate [2] omits the HAL layer entirely and splits “Libraries” vs “Native Libraries” in a way that doesn’t match the intended 5-layer illustration. Candidate [3] has the correct layer structure and components, but includes some incorrect/misplaced associations in the extra explanatory text. Candidate [4] contains strong hallucinations (e.g., “Mercury Garbage Collection” and “TCP protocols” between layers), which makes it the least reliable despite meeting the component-count requirement.
